_source: C:/Users/marsi/Downloads/beacon_phone_magsafe_2p5mm_Latest.scad, default parameters. Values from OpenSCAD 2021.01 run headless (ECHO lines plus a wrapper that echoes every derived variable); cross-checked against the STL (outer box, floor, board and jack Z levels match).
_frame: BOARD coordinates: origin = board lower-left corner seen from the component (top) side, USB-C edge at the bottom (y=0), +x right, +y toward the top of the phone. Z is given as absolute enclosure Z (0 = phone-contact face) and/or relative to the board top or bottom, as named.
_kicad_note: KiCad's Y axis points down. With the board lower-left at KiCad (X0, Y0): kicad_x = X0 + x, kicad_y = Y0 - y. Arcs are CCW here and become CW on screen, so use start/mid/end points (unambiguous). Components on the top side of the board = F.Cu.

transform.enclosure_frame: origin = MagSafe ring centre on the phone-contact face; +Y toward the top of the phone; +X right seen from the back of the phone; +Z away from the phone. Axes are parallel to the board axes (no rotation, no mirror).

board.outline_polygon_note: CCW, 8 segments per 90-degree corner, closing segment implied. Notch inner corners are square in the scad; the router rounds them (r ~0.4-0.5), which still clears the jack body (0.2 to the notch floor, 0.3 per side).

tx_notch.formula: depth = sma_body[1] + 0.2 - tx_gap = 1.6 + 0.2 - 0.3; half-width tx_nw = sma_body[0]/2 + 0.3 = 3.55

board.standoff_pad_keepout_note: 6 mm standoff under the board at each hole, cavity floor to board bottom. The scad echo says keep 6 mm pads clear on BOTH sides.
board.screw: 4x M2 x 4 pan/cheese head, top-down into M2 x 3 heat-set inserts, 2.4 thread engagement

screw_head_keepout_top.note: scad clearance checks use screw_head_d/2 + 0.3 = 2.2 radius

ring_annulus.note: pocket radii include mag_clr. Projected onto the board the annulus spans x 0.3..54.7, y 23.75..78.15.

usb.opening_shape: open-top U through the bottom wall, closed by the lid; U bottom at enclosure z 5.6, 0.12 below the board bottom

rx_patch.part: Taoglas WDP.2458.25.4.B.02, pin-fed 25x25x4 ceramic patch, taped to the top side
rx_patch.radome_note: lid underside recessed 0.4 (lid_t - patch_cover) over this square, leaving a 1.2 radome; there the lid underside is 5.8 above the board top
rx_patch.feed_pin_below_note: scad assumes pin length - board thickness (ignores the 0.3 tape)

tx_jack.part: edge-launch SMA(F) jack (standard SMA) for Taoglas GW.26.0111

body_rect.note: body bears on the inner wall face (board x 55.3); its back face is 0.2 beyond the notch floor (x 53.5)

height_limits.top_clear_note: board top to lid underside, zero margin (lid underside at z 12.72). Set by the patch stack 4.4 + 1.0 air. The scad's design value for the tallest ordinary part is top_parts_h = 3.3 (+0.5 margin = 3.8).
height_limits.lid_lip_band_note: lid lip (1.2 thick, 3.0 deep) covers the board from its edge inward 1.1 (lip outer face 0.1 outside the board edge). Lip bottom is 2.4 above the board top. The band follows the board outline; its inner corner radius is 1.9, concentric with the 3.0 board corners. The lip is cut away (full 5.4 available) at the USB-C and TX gaps below.
height_limits.below_board_note: board bottom to cavity floor (z 5.72 - 4.16), no margin built in. pcb_gap parameter = 1.5 (minimum, rounded up to a layer). The scad gives the patch pin a 0.3 margin.
height_limits.below_board_standoffs: 6 mm diameter standoffs fill the whole gap under each hole

snap_beads.note: beads sit on the lip's OUTER face and click into 0.35-deep grooves in the wall; they add no intrusion over the board beyond the lip band

pry_notch.note: cut in the outer half of the bottom wall at the seam (z 11.52-12.72); no intrusion over the board

tx_slot.note: U-slot from the barrel axis up through the wall top, closed by a 6.55-wide lid tongue

edge_intrusions.screw_heads: 3.8 heads at the holes reach 1.6 from the board edges (0.5 inboard of the 1.1 lip band); head top 1.6 above the board top, below the 2.4 lip bottom

tx_pos_allowed_right_or_left_edge.note: corner-radius assert (line 379) gives 6.925..71.525; snap beads at board y 18.95 and 48.95 on both side walls exclude +/-10.425 (line 332)

usb_centre_x_allowed.note: corner assert (line 348) gives 9.3..45.7; pry notch at board x 43.5 (pry_x 16) needs |pry_x - usb_x| >= 11.3 (line 339), so the upper limit is 32.2
